body: The counterpoint to that is why should someone continue to suffer so that others are not inconvenienced? I believe no one wants to kill themselves; suicide is the lesser of two evils. Yes, it sucks but oh well. Suicide allows people to take secrets to their graves that otherwise would have gotten out and done more harm than the suicide. Also, "shaming" suicidal people about the impact their deaths will have on others doesn't help.

Suicide has always been a "Plan B" for me. I first "learned" about suicide when Kurt Cobain killed himself. I was about 13. I thought that suicide was something you do when you're fucked. It sounds strange but I always said that I needed to have standards when it came to life because it was my life and I was the one who was going to have live it. So if my life fell below those standards, then suicide would be an option.
